name: set_option
description: Replace the whole ECharts option (a JSON object). Series read tables with datasetId and encode.

name: patch_option
description: Set one value in the option at a JSON pointer such as /series/0/encode/y (/- appends to an array). The value is JSON as itself (an object, not its JSON text). The parent must exist: to style a series without lineStyle, set /series/0/lineStyle to {"color": "red"}, not /series/0/lineStyle/color.

name: remove_option_key
description: Remove the value at a JSON pointer from the option.

name: set_table
description: Replace a table's rows, or add a table with this id; rows is an array of objects.

name: reorder_tables
description: Move a table to index (0 is first): the first one is the option's default dataset.

name: compile_report
description: Whether the option draws: errors, warnings, the tables, the series and the SVG's size.

name: describe_tables
description: Every table's columns with type, min, max, distinct and null counts, and 3 sample rows.
